# Vendored files

`preact-htm.module.js` is htm 3.1.1's standalone build: htm with Preact 10 and its hooks in one ES module. It exports `html`, `render`, `h`, `Component`, `createContext` and the hooks (`useState`, `useEffect`, `useRef`, `useLayoutEffect`, `useMemo`, `useCallback` and the rest).

- Source: https://unpkg.com/htm@3.1.1/preact/standalone.module.js
- SHA-256: `72284e8e9079c87817145df1110f74e8a2aa040b2fc384922e18dfcb46fc1fd7`
- Licences: htm is Apache-2.0 (https://github.com/developit/htm), Preact is MIT (https://github.com/preactjs/preact).

Update by downloading a newer standalone build, checking the exports above, and replacing the version and hash here.
